name: Valley of Siddim

identification.note: Traditionally identified with the area now under the Dead Sea's shallow southern basin, though this is not archaeologically provable.

related_people.name: Arioch
related_people.role: king of Ellasar, in the eastern coalition that fought here

related_people.name: Bera
related_people.role: king of Sodom, defeated in the battle here

related_people.name: Birsha
related_people.role: king of Gomorrah, defeated in the battle here

related_people.name: Chedorlaomer
related_people.role: king of Elam, who led the coalition to victory here and carried off Lot

related_people.name: Shemeber
related_people.role: king of Zeboiim, defeated in the battle here

description: "The Salt Sea" valley where the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, and three other cities battled an invading coalition led by Chedorlaomer of Elam and were defeated, with Lot taken captive among the spoil — prompting Abraham's rescue mission (Genesis 14:1-16).
